steps.text: 6:03 P.M. \ Overcast \ Visibility: 19 km
Desert by Lungmen \ Facility #14

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...I've reached the destination.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: No other abnormalities found.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Report complete.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Frostleaf, why were you frowning the whole way here?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I'm just a little concerned about Amiya's group.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: They've already safely returned to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Nearl and Dobermann already left Lungmen a week ago for their next assignment.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It must be a pretty tough mission if it required sending those two together.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Blacksteel and Penguin Logistics both have their own matters to attend to.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh, Liskarm and Franka...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm... I'm glad that they're safe...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: You've got to work hard as well, just like them.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: When Franka sent you over to me, she spoke very highly of you.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: R-really...?

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: If only you weren't so timid, she said.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Uuu....

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...Hey, don't act like you're about to start crying!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Aren't you also a member of Blacksteel...?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I, I'm not... crying...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...In any case, let's continue our mission.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Our next task is to work with the other recon teams to scout out this entire city.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Other than searching for survivors, we also need to assess the situation.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: If we encounter hostile Infected, we'll have to deal with the threat quickly.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Even though our mission isn't particularly dangerous, it's still best to proceed with caution.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: In the event that Reunion is involved in this, we'll retreat immediately and report back to Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Mmhm, mmhm!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: All that's left for us to do... is to focus on our job.
6:12 P.M. \ Overcast \ Visibility: 19 km
Rhodes Island
Deserted Nomadic City - 2 days after the discovery of 'Facility #14'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah... You made it, Doctor.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Good timing, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Our job here is about done. You probably won't see us for a while~

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We'll see you soon enough.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It won't be long before we're back on standby in Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't miss me too much.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well, unfortunately, we don't have such an official-sounding reason. Right, Texas?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hold on a second...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Penguin Logistics... is about to go on vacation!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's only going to one precious day... But still--

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Apologies. This isn't the best time to talk about it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry... Everyone needs to get some rest.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...I should be the one saying that to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's right, that's right. Amiya, girl, you really need a bit of R&R!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are many things in Rhodes Island that must be taken care of...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can understand that, but make sure not to give yourself too much pressure, Amiya.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: No matter how strong your will is, your body won't be able to keep up if you get exhausted.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You'd better not get sick. Everyone's counting on you!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... Everyone has always been looking after me.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We were also inspired by the way you fight.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just that much is enough.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Since I'm already here, I'll take this opportunity to get a free check-up before heading back.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Our work here is about done anyway. Next up is...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm listening.

steps.name: Franka & Exusiai
steps.text: Keep up the good work~! Cheer up!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Wha... huh?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: After we finish our report, we'll be right back.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: No matter what, life must move forward.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Amiya, take care.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone... I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I will. You all take care as well.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: See you next time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor,

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have to visit the slums in outer Lungmen again. I should be of assistance.

options: Will you be fine by yourself?
Amiya, should I go with you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Another member of Rhodes Island, Projekt Red, will be joining me in Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She's really good!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With her there, you don't have to worry about me.
